unresolved_decisions: accept blanket cross-symbol BTC/ETH common-market clustering

known_limitations: blanket BTC/ETH common-market grouping may over-cluster unrelated cross-symbol events
a fixed four-hour horizon may not capture slower common shocks
concentration is descriptive and has no accepted threshold
policy has not been run against real candidate events in this phase

normative_specification.concentration_calculation: largest cluster member-event count divided by total member-event count; zero for an empty cluster set
normative_specification.cross_symbol_common_market_overlap_rule: cluster overlapping events across symbols sharing the futures-um BTC/ETH market context
normative_specification.duplicate_handling: byte-equivalent event IDs are ignored; conflicting duplicate IDs fail
normative_specification.event_cluster_algorithm: validate and canonical-deduplicate retained events; sort by decision timestamp then event ID; sweep left-to-right; each event occupies [decision, decision+max(spacing,horizon)); merge transitively while next decision is strictly before active end
fail_closed_conditions: missing decision timestamp or required context
normative_specification.horizon_overlap_rule: all 240-minute decision horizons are half-open and transitively merged
normative_specification.independent_sample_definition: one complete cluster is one independent sample; member events never count independently
normative_specification.same_symbol_overlap_rule: cluster when half-open decision horizons overlap
normative_specification.timestamp_boundary_semantics: an event exactly at the active cluster end starts a new cluster
normative_specification.versioning_and_mutation_rules: any normative field mutation creates a new hash/version and requires a fresh governance decision

rationale: The four-hour rule groups overlapping outcome horizons and common-market shocks to avoid pseudoreplication; sample-count maximization is not an objective.

synthetic_test_vectors.name: transitive overlap, exact boundary, and input-order invariance
